title: Students face ‘ticking timebomb’ of debt and higher taxes

paragraphs.en: The government is piling mountains of debt and higher tax rates on young people heading to university, according to analysis into the “ticking timebomb” of costs faced by future students.
paragraphs.zh: 根据对即将到来的学生所面临的“定时炸弹”式成本的分析，政府正把堆积如山的债务和更高的税率压到即将升入大学的年轻人身上。

paragraphs.en: Hundreds of thousands of sixth formers will receive their A-level results on Thursday, with many expecting to continue on to higher education courses.
paragraphs.zh: 成千上万的六年级学生将于周四收到他们的 A-level 成绩，其中许多人期望继续升入高等教育课程。

paragraphs.en: But Toby Whelton, author of the analysis for the Intergenerational Foundation , a thinktank, says those in England will face more extreme financial penalties than previous graduates.
paragraphs.zh: 但智库代际基金会（Intergenerational Foundation）这份分析的作者托比·惠尔顿（Toby Whelton）表示，英格兰的学生将比以往的毕业生面临更严重的财务惩罚。

paragraphs.en: Whelton said the cost of paying for university education has been shifted almost entirely on to current students, with the latest student loan package – known as plan 5 (which began in August 2023) – meaning young graduates will struggle to save for house deposits or pension contributions, delaying their key milestones.
paragraphs.zh: 惠尔顿表示，支付大学教育的成本几乎已经完全转移到现在的学生身上，最新的学生贷款方案——即所谓的第 5 计划（Plan 5，始于 2023 年 8 月）——意味着年轻毕业生将难以存钱支付购房首付或养老金供款，从而推迟他们人生中的关键里程碑。

paragraphs.en: Related: UK universities warn of cuts for impoverished students if dire funding issues continue
paragraphs.zh: 相关报道：英国大学警告称，若资金困境持续，贫困学生将面临削减

paragraphs.en: “The burden of student loans has never been higher. By stealth and with minimal democratic scrutiny, successive governments have piled costs on to young graduates in the hope that nobody would notice,” said Whelton.
paragraphs.zh: “学生贷款的负担从未如此沉重。历届政府以隐秘的方式、在最少的民主监督下，把成本堆到年轻毕业生头上，希望没有人会注意到，”惠尔顿说。

paragraphs.en: “Plan 5 in particular has received far too little attention. It is a ticking timebomb, set to detonate as today’s students enter the workforce and confront repayment terms harsher than those faced by previous cohorts.”
paragraphs.zh: “尤其是第 5 计划，受到的关注实在太少。它是一枚定时炸弹，将在今天的学生进入劳动力市场、面对比前几代人更苛刻的还款条款时引爆。”

paragraphs.en: The report by the Intergenerational Foundation details how successive governments since 2010 have increased the costs ​for students in England.
paragraphs.zh: 代际基金会的这份报告详细阐述了自 2010 年以来，历届政府如何不断提高英格兰学生的成本。
